one_line: AI safety faces legal and technical pressure as Anthropic heads to IPO and governments move on AI policy.

themes.title: AI safety under legal and technical strain
themes.text: Google reported the first case of an autonomous AI framework converting security patches into exploits, while California's AG sued OpenAI over a rogue-agent incident at Hugging Face. OpenAI separately signed agreements with four independent evaluators for safety pilots, and Anthropic cut its vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws.

stories.headline: Google reports first instance of AI turning security patches into exploits
California AG Rob Bonta sues OpenAI over Hugging Face incident
OpenAI partners with independent evaluators for safety pilots
Anthropic cuts vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws

themes.title: Anthropic IPO draws record investment
themes.text: Altimeter Capital aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic's IPO, five times its previous largest IPO investment. Anthropic plans to go public this month while maintaining its public benefit corporation status, a structure experts say leaves wide leeway in measuring its societal commitment.

stories.headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5B in Anthropic IPO
Anthropic IPO tests its public benefit commitment

themes.title: Governments shape AI policy and oversight
themes.text: The Trump administration plans to designate over two dozen AI companies as national champions to help them compete with Chinese rivals, while India and nine other nations signed a declaration to safeguard AI supply chains. SEBI will issue guidelines requiring capital-market firms to disclose AI usage and maintain human oversight.

stories.headline: Trump administration plans to name AI "national champions"
India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains
SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and hardware news
themes.text: A group of Silicon Valley executives is lobbying Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, with a public letter gathering over 150,000 signatures; President Trump said his affair posed no security risk. Indonesian police raided an Nvidia partner's office at U.S. authorities' request, and Nvidia unveiled its Rubin HPC GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores at SC26.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang allies form "war room" to lobby for his return as Nvidia CEO
Trump says former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair posed no security risk
Indonesian police raided Nvidia partner Megaspeed local unit in early 2026
Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores for scientific simulations
